metadata.question: Does the sea surface temperature in the eastern tropical Pacific decrease in November 2021, compared with the long-term average during November?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: NOAA/CDO/OISST_V2 (daily sea surface temperature) - Date: November 2021 for current, and a long-term average (e.g., 1982-2020) for baseline - Location: Eastern Tropical Pacific - approximately 10°S to 10°N, 90°W to 180°W 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for SST data (ocean surface) - May need to mask land pixels if present 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - SST typically ranges from -2°C to 35°C - Check if collection has data (.size()) - Check if valid pixels exist (reducer count) - Check if result is None/NaN - Compare Nov 2021 mean vs long-term Nov mean: if Nov2021 < long-term, answer A; otherwise B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry for Eastern Tropical Pacific const geometry = ee.Geometry.Rectangle({ coords: [-180, -10, -90, 10], proj: 'EPSG:4326', geodesic: false }); // 2. Define time periods const nov2021Start = '2021-11-01'; const nov2021End = '2021-11-30'; const longTermStart = '1982-11-01'; const longTermEnd = '2020-11-30'; // 3. Load SST data for November 2021 const sst2021 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDO/OISST_V2') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(nov2021Start, nov2021End) .select('sst'); const size2021 = sst2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Nov 2021 Images: ${size2021}`); if (size2021 === 0) { console.log("No data for November 2021."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Load long-term SST data for November (1982-2020) const sstLongTerm = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDO/OISST_V2') .filterBounds(geometry) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(11, 11, 'month')) .filterDate(longTermStart, longTermEnd) .select('sst'); const sizeLongTerm = sstLongTerm.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Long-term Nov Images (1982-2020): ${sizeLongTerm}`); if (sizeLongTerm === 0) { console.log("No long-term data for November."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 5. Calculate mean SST for both periods const mean2021 = sst2021.mean(); const meanLongTerm = sstLongTerm.mean(); // 6. Get statistics with pixel count validation const stats2021 = mean2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: geometry, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const statsLongTerm = meanLongTerm.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: geometry, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const count2021 = stats2021.sst_count; const countLongTerm = statsLongTerm.sst_count; console.log(`Nov 2021 valid pixels: ${count2021}`); console.log(`Long-term Nov valid pixels: ${countLongTerm}`); if (count2021 === 0 || countLongTerm === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } const sstValue2021 = stats2021.sst_mean; const sstValueLongTerm = statsLongTerm.sst_mean; console.log(`Nov 2021 mean SST: ${sstValue2021.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Long-term Nov mean SST: ${sstValueLongTerm.toFixed(2)}°C`); // 7. Validation and final answer if (sstValue2021 === null || sstValue2021 === undefined || isNaN(sstValue2021) || sstValueLongTerm === null || sstValueLongTerm === undefined || isNaN(sstValueLongTerm)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid SST values."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (sstValue2021 < -5 || sstValue2021 > 40 || sstValueLongTerm < -5 || sstValueLongTerm > 40) { console.log("SST values out of valid range."); console.log("C3"); return; } const difference = sstValue2021 - sstValueLongTerm; console.log(`Difference (2021 - Long-term): ${difference.toFixed(2)}°C`); if (sstValue2021 < sstValueLongTerm) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
